summary: Zammad is an open-source ticketing and support system designed to help teams manage customer service requests and communication channels in one place. It organizes incoming queries into a structured queue for tracking, assignment, and resolution. The software is released under the AGPL-3.0 licence and built using Ruby.
goodFor: It suits teams that require a self-hosted support desk platform to handle incoming customer inquiries and streamline ticketing workflows.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence carries strict copyleft obligations if you modify the code and offer it as a network service, and deployment requires managing a Ruby-based stack alongside associated database dependencies.
deployNotes: Because it relies on Ruby and packages distributed as deb files, you will typically need to provision a separate database backend, configure a reverse proxy for TLS termination, and ensure persistent storage is attached for user data.
